title: Report Analyzes US STEM Talent Pipeline and Global Competitiveness
summary: A comprehensive index combining decades of data assesses how the United States develops, attracts, deploys, and retains its STEM workforce.

title: Retrofitting Residential Septic Tanks for Biogas in Lagos
summary: A study evaluates retrofitting residential septic infrastructure in Lagos for decentralised biogas production, estimating a methane yield of 10.89 m3/day.

title: Exolaunch and Space Cargo Book Starship Starfall Missions
summary: Exolaunch and Space Cargo have booked missions on SpaceX's Starship utilizing the Starfall reentry capsule.

summary: Semtech introduced a family of 224G linear transimpedance amplifiers and drivers at CIOE to support near-packaged and co-packaged optics architectures.

title: New Process Converts Plastic Waste Into Fuel
summary: Scientists at Oak Ridge National Laboratory used molten salts to break down polyethylene plastic into gasoline and diesel-like fuels.

title: Scaling Physical AI and Edge Robotics
summary: Scaling vision-language-action robotics demands optimized inference, heterogeneous compute, and real-time control on edge hardware.

title: Needle-Thin Multi-Function Brain Implant
summary: Researchers created a flexible, needle-thin brain implant capable of recording neural activity, delivering drugs, and stimulating multiple regions.

title: CXMT Expands into NAND Flash
summary: DRAM specialist CXMT is moving into NAND flash to capitalize on AI-driven storage shortages.

title: Gran Sasso Experiment Tests Gravity Quantum Theory

title: Leaders Discuss Structural Shifts for Airport Infrastructure Delivery
summary: Infrastructure and aviation leaders gathered to debate how new methodologies and collaboration can benefit airport delivery.

title: Defining Human Driver Digital Twins and Engineering Challenges
summary: Researchers explore the definitions, use cases, and engineering challenges associated with Human Driver Digital Twins in the automotive domain.

title: Agentic AI Automates Design-Rule Repair for Chips
summary: Purdue University researchers developed a closed-loop agentic framework that automates local design-rule corrections while preserving layout equivalence.

title: Unified Chiplet Network Scales Neuromorphic Systems
summary: Heidelberg University researchers presented a unified interconnection network for chiplet-based scaling of neuromorphic computing systems.

title: Bio-Inspired Approach Recovers Rare Earth Elements from Coal Ash
